body: This Saturday: Hacktoberfest Hack Day in Hampton. RevolutionVA and AI Collective Hampton Roads are hosting a free, all-ages hack day on Saturday, October 17, from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM at the 757 Makerspace (16 Murray St, Hampton). The focus is building and learning with open-source AI: open-weight models, open-source agents, and whatever you want to try with them. Breakfast refreshments and lunch are provided, and you don't need a project idea to show up. Bring a laptop and a charger. Register on the MLH event page so we can plan food for you.
One travel note: the HRBT will be closed heading out of Hampton that day, so plan on the Monitor-Merrimac for the trip home.
We are always looking for topic and speaker suggestions. Let us know if you have thoughts! Just hit reply, or come find us in Slack or Discord.
